note: 篝火边讲鬼故事的三只熊之一(另有 Keith / Ede),三人轮流把同一个押韵的小熊恐怖故事讲下去,翻译要当成一首连贯的故事诗来处理,不要逐句孤立地翻。

messages.raw: §fPal, you seem a lil' lost over there,
messages.text: Pal, you seem a lil' lost over there,
messages.zh: 老兄,你在那边看着有点迷路啊,

messages.raw: §fIt's the scary story about the big bad bear
messages.text: It's the scary story about the big bad bear
messages.zh: 这是个关于大坏熊的恐怖故事

messages.raw: §fthey'd always throw tantrums about what and who,
messages.text: they'd always throw tantrums about what and who,
messages.zh: 他们总为了这个那个、为了谁谁谁大发脾气,

messages.raw: §fbut what came of that, let me tell you, it didn't end very good
messages.text: but what came of that, let me tell you, it didn't end very good
messages.zh: 至于后来怎么样了嘛,我告诉你,结局可不太好

messages.raw: §f"so he sat down by the chimney with paws freezing cold,
messages.text: "so he sat down by the chimney with paws freezing cold,
messages.zh: “于是他在烟囱边坐了下来,爪子冻得冰凉,

messages.raw: §fbut then something happened, the fire went out and he heard a loud creak
messages.text: but then something happened, the fire went out and he heard a loud creak
messages.zh: 可就在这时出事了,火灭了,他听见「咯吱」一声巨响

messages.raw: §fHorror stories are better when you have something to snack on y'know? If you help us gather some ingredients, we could roast some tasty marshmallows.
messages.text: Horror stories are better when you have something to snack on y'know? If you help us gather some ingredients, we could roast some tasty marshmallows.
messages.zh: 恐怖故事嘛,边听边有点零嘴才带劲,你说是吧?你要是帮我们凑齐材料,咱们就能烤点香喷喷的棉花糖。

messages.raw: §fThanks Pal! Why don't you sit around the campfire with us and enjoy these tasty treats?
messages.text: Thanks Pal! Why don't you sit around the campfire with us and enjoy these tasty treats?
messages.zh: 谢啦老兄! 不如就坐在篝火边和我们一起,好好享用这些好吃的?

messages.raw: §fNo supplies? You wouldn't want to experience what the lil' bear did, would you?
messages.text: No supplies? You wouldn't want to experience what the lil' bear did, would you?
messages.zh: 没带东西?你总不想亲身体验一遍小熊的遭遇吧?
